item.title: Teen Still Hurt 6 Years After Mom Abandoned Him Because Of A Tantrum, Lashes Out At Her Engagement Party
item.description: Family is complicated. We can love people deeply and still end up hurting them—and being hurt in return. That push and pull can leave messy situations and lasting wounds. One teen got caught up in one and took to Reddit to share his rocky relationship with his mom. Feeling like she abandoned him, he reached a breaking point and took his anger out on her during what was supposed to be a special engagement party. Now he’s asking if he was in the wrong, and readers are divided.

item.title: “Harry Styles, You’ve Changed”: Fans Outraged At The Prices Of Harry Styles’ New Tour Tickets
item.description: "POV: you're getting robbed," fans captioned the videos of themselves waiting in the Ticketmaster queue for Harry Styles' "Together, Together" tour. "See rich people all the time, fans occasionally," others quipped, referring to his new album "Kiss All The Time. Disco Occasionally." Some called for a boycott; others blamed the singer for choosing dynamic pricing (some tickets climbed as high as $1,000).

item.description: Relationships are rarely straightforward, and many of the potential problems you might run into with someone aren’t obvious until the two of you are actually together.
